title: QA Rails — Multi-Model Review

panels.description: Total qa_pass_completed events in the selected time window.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "QA Passes" FROM audit_log WHERE event_type = 'qa_pass_completed' AND COALESCE(details->>'terminal','true') <> 'false' AND timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours';

panels.title: QA pass 24h

panels.description: Fraction of QA passes that ended with approved=true. Higher = pipeline producing publishable drafts.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN (details->>'approved')::boolean THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 0)::float AS "Approval Rate" FROM audit_log WHERE event_type = 'qa_pass_completed' AND COALESCE(details->>'terminal','true') <> 'false' AND timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours';

panels.title: Appr % 24h

panels.description: Count of MemoryClient.search → rag_engine fallbacks in the last 24h. The rail is operator-opt-in (rag_engine_enabled=true); a non-zero count means an enabled rail is failing and silently reverting to the legacy pgvector path. RED at 1+ — investigate and either fix the retriever or set rag_engine_enabled=false. Per `feedback_no_silent_defaults` — operator-enabled rails must never silently degrade.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "rag_engine Fallbacks" FROM audit_log WHERE event_type = 'rag_engine_fallback' AND timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours';

panels.title: RAG fallback

panels.description: QA passes per hour, split by approved/rejected. Lets you spot regressions when a model swap or prompt change tanks the approval rate.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', timestamp) AS time, CASE WHEN (details->>'approved')::boolean THEN 'approved' ELSE 'rejected' END AS metric, COUNT(*)::int AS value FROM audit_log WHERE event_type = 'qa_pass_completed' AND COALESCE(details->>'terminal','true') <> 'false' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: QA Passes per Hour (approved vs rejected)

panels.description: Count of QA reviewer skips in the last 24h. Each row is one operator-enabled rail (deepeval g_eval / faithfulness, guardrails brand / competitor, ragas_eval) raising at runtime — chain still completes without that rail's signal, but the failure is surfaced loudly per `feedback_no_silent_defaults`. Click into the audit_log to see which reviewer + exception. RED at 1+.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Reviewer Skips" FROM audit_log WHERE event_type = 'qa_reviewer_failure' AND timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours';

panels.title: Skips (24h)

panels.description: Per-reviewer skip count in the last 24h — which rails are flaking. Empty table = all rails healthy.

targets.rawSql: SELECT details->>'reviewer' AS "Reviewer", details->>'exception_type' AS "Exception", COUNT(*)::int AS "Skips", MAX(timestamp) AS "Last" FROM audit_log WHERE event_type = 'qa_reviewer_failure' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY "Skips" DESC

panels.title: Per-Reviewer Skips (window)

panels.description: For each reviewer in the last 24h: how often it ran, what fraction approved, average score, and whether it was advisory or required-to-pass on each call. Drives the per-rail false-positive analysis Lane D was built to enable.

targets.rawSql:
WITH expanded AS (
  SELECT al.timestamp,
         (al.details->>'approved')::boolean AS pass_approved,
         r.value->>'reviewer' AS reviewer,
         r.value->>'provider' AS provider,
         (r.value->>'approved')::boolean AS reviewer_approved,
         (r.value->>'score')::float AS reviewer_score,
         (r.value->>'advisory')::boolean AS advisory
  FROM audit_log al
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(al.details->'reviews') AS r(value)
  WHERE al.event_type = 'qa_pass_completed'
    AND al.timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
)
SELECT reviewer AS "Reviewer",
       provider AS "Provider",
       COUNT(*)::int AS "Runs",
       AVG(CASE WHEN reviewer_approved THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)::float AS "Approval Rate",
       ROUND(AVG(reviewer_score)::numeric, 1) AS "Avg Score",
       SUM(CASE WHEN advisory THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::int AS "Advisory Calls",
       SUM(CASE WHEN NOT advisory AND NOT reviewer_approved THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::int AS "Hard Vetoes"
FROM expanded
GROUP BY reviewer, provider
ORDER BY "Runs" DESC;

panels.title: Per-Reviewer Stats (24h)

panels.description: Average score per reviewer (24h). Skips reviewers with <5 runs to avoid noise.

targets.rawSql: WITH expanded AS ( SELECT r.value->>'reviewer' AS reviewer, (r.value->>'score')::float AS reviewer_score FROM audit_log al CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(al.details->'reviews') AS r(value) WHERE al.event_type = 'qa_pass_completed' AND $__timeFilter(al.timestamp) ) SELECT reviewer AS metric, ROUND(AVG(reviewer_score)::numeric, 1) AS value FROM expanded GROUP BY reviewer ORDER BY value DESC

panels.title: Avg Score by Reviewer (window)

panels.description: Last 20 QA passes — full reviewer breakdown in the details column. Click into a row to copy the JSON for a deeper trace.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT timestamp AS "Time",
       (details->>'approved')::boolean AS "Approved",
       COALESCE(details->>'terminal','true')::boolean AS "Terminal",
       COALESCE((details->>'qa_rewrite_attempts')::int, 0) AS "Rewrites",
       (details->>'final_score')::float AS "Final Score",
       (details->>'reviewer_count')::int AS "Reviewers",
       task_id AS "Task ID",
       details AS "Details (JSON)"
FROM audit_log
WHERE event_type = 'qa_pass_completed'
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 20;

panels.title: Latest 20 QA Passes

panels.description: Panel-level 7d window (dashboard default is 24h): Ragas runs only on posts with retrieval context, so 24h is often legitimately empty.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT timestamp AS time,
       'ragas_score' AS metric,
       (details->>'score')::float AS value
FROM audit_log
WHERE event_type = 'ragas_score'
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY timestamp;

panels.title: Ragas Score Over Time

panels.description: Count of ragas_eval calls in the dashboard time range. Zero with ragas_enabled=true → ragas_eval is broken; investigate Reviewer Skips panel above. High count = every QA pass is paying the ~6K-token judge cost — consider sampling.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Ragas Evals"
FROM audit_log
WHERE event_type = 'ragas_score'
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp);

panels.title: Ragas Evals (window)

panels.description: Last 10 Ragas evaluations with task linkage and component breakdown. Component scores below 0 are sentinels — that metric's judge-LLM call failed on that pass (other components still feed the average). Click into a row to read the raw JSONB and correlate with the originating task.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT timestamp AS "Time",
       task_id AS "Task ID",
       (details->>'score')::float AS "Score",
       (details->>'faithfulness')::float AS "Faithfulness",
       (details->>'answer_relevancy')::float AS "Answer Relevancy",
       (details->>'context_precision')::float AS "Context Precision",
       details->>'topic' AS "Topic"
FROM audit_log
WHERE event_type = 'ragas_score'
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 10;

panels.title: Last 10 Ragas Evaluations
Self-Heal Before Paging — Flag vs Discard

panels.description: Self-heal-before-paging (qa_flag_instead_of_reject). 'flagged' = drafts QA found non-approvable but kept for operator review (audit_log event_type='qa_flagged_surfaced'); 'discarded' = hard rejects that halted the graph (qa_pass_completed, not approved). Before the switch is flipped the flagged series is empty by design; after, watch flagged rise and discarded fall toward only true fabrication/gate vetoes.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', timestamp) AS time, 'flagged (kept for review)' AS metric, COUNT(*)::int AS value FROM audit_log WHERE event_type = 'qa_flagged_surfaced' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT date_trunc('hour', timestamp) AS time, 'discarded (hard reject)' AS metric, COUNT(*)::int AS value FROM audit_log WHERE event_type = 'qa_pass_completed' AND COALESCE(details->>'terminal','true') <> 'false' AND NOT COALESCE((details->>'approved')::boolean, false) AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: QA Flagged vs Discarded per Hour

panels.description: Top 10 reasons operators have rejected tasks at a gate in the selected time window. Helps identify recurring quality issues that prompt engineering or the QA rails should address. Powered by audit_log rows where event_type='approval_gate_rejected' (#149).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    details->>'gate_name' AS "Gate",
    details->>'reason'   AS "Reason",
    COUNT(*)::int        AS "Count",
    MAX(timestamp)       AS "Last Seen"
FROM audit_log
WHERE event_type = 'approval_gate_rejected'
  AND details->>'reason' IS NOT NULL
  AND details->>'reason' != ''
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY "Count" DESC
LIMIT 10;

panels.title: Top 10 Rejection Reasons (by count, current window)

panels.description: Share of image_relevance (vision_gate) reviews in the window that PASSED OPEN — the vision scorer no-op'd (model/infra unavailable) and the gate accepted without looking. 0% is healthy; a sustained high value means the vision leg is dark (it ran at 100% silently for weeks pre-fix). Vacuous passes (no images to assess) are excluded from the denominator.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r->>'feedback_preview' ILIKE '%passing open%') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r->>'feedback_preview' NOT ILIKE '%vacuity%'), 0), 0) AS "pass-open %" FROM audit_log, LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(details->'reviews') r WHERE event_type = 'qa_pass_completed' AND r->>'reviewer' = 'image_relevance' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp);

panels.title: Vision pass-open % (window)

panels.description: qa.vision image_relevance reviews per day: scored (the vision model actually looked) vs pass_open (scorer unavailable, gate accepted blind) vs vacuous_pass (no images to assess). The scored share should dominate; pass_open bars are the vision_scorer_unavailable finding's trend line.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', timestamp) AS time, CASE WHEN r->>'feedback_preview' ILIKE '%passing open%' THEN 'pass_open' WHEN r->>'feedback_preview' ILIKE '%vacuity%' THEN 'vacuous_pass' ELSE 'scored' END AS metric, COUNT(*)::int AS value FROM audit_log, LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(details->'reviews') r WHERE event_type = 'qa_pass_completed' AND r->>'reviewer' = 'image_relevance' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Blog vision reviews per day (scored vs pass-open)

panels.description: Per-shot render-check outcomes per day (video_shot_rendered, successful renders only). accepted/regenerated = scored; unscored = scorer no-op'd, shot accepted blind (emits vision_scorer_unavailable); skipped_reused = holdover/pexels-miss reusing an already-vetted clip (by design); none = QA disabled or pre-fix rows where the outcome wasn't stamped.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', timestamp) AS time, COALESCE(details->>'qa_outcome', CASE WHEN details->>'qa_score' IS NOT NULL THEN 'scored' ELSE 'none' END) AS metric, COUNT(*)::int AS value FROM audit_log WHERE event_type = 'video_shot_rendered' AND (details->>'success')::boolean AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Shot render-check outcomes per day
QA rail skip ratio by reviewer
panels.description: Fraction of the last N passes each rail was SKIPPED (empty research_context / disabled judge / unresolvable). 1.0 = skipping every pass. Only currently-skipping rails emit a series. gap-fill (poindexter#855): live Prometheus metric that was on no dashboard
Rescue rewrites scheduled vs converted to a terminal approve in the selected window (poindexter#986). The 2026-07 loop ran 0-for-116 unnoticed; ProbeRescueYieldJob pages on a zero-yield streak.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE details->>'rescue_deferred' = 'true') AS "Attempts", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE details->>'terminal' = 'true' AND details->>'approved' = 'true' AND COALESCE((details->>'qa_rewrite_attempts')::int, 0) >= 1) AS "Rescued", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE details->>'terminal' = 'true' AND details->>'approved' = 'true' AND COALESCE((details->>'qa_rewrite_attempts')::int, 0) >= 1) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE details->>'rescue_deferred' = 'true'), 0), 1) AS "Yield %" FROM audit_log WHERE event_type = 'qa_pass_completed' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp);

panels.title: Rescue yield (window)

panels.description: Terminal QA decisions that went through >= 1 rescue rewrite — did the revision convert the reject or not.

targets.rawSql: SELECT timestamp AS time, LEFT(task_id::text, 8) AS task, details->>'approved' AS approved, (details->>'final_score')::numeric AS score, (details->>'qa_rewrite_attempts')::int AS rewrites FROM audit_log WHERE event_type = 'qa_pass_completed' AND details->>'terminal' = 'true' AND COALESCE((details->>'qa_rewrite_attempts')::int, 0) >= 1 AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 10;

panels.title: Rescued decisions (window)

description: CHARTER: per-reviewer QA behavior — pass rates, score distributions, and what the rails veto. Answers 'are the quality gates doing their job, and which rail is the outlier?'.
